title: 12 loài cá Sobi Aquarium (theo content)
decisions: Looks follow asset/AQUARIUM_ART_PLAN.md §5.4 and content/aquarium/fish.json (12 species, rarity common → epic: rarer fish get finer fins and richer colours). The 8 decorative fish of the owner's aquarium-01-scene sheet F are not these species and stay decoration. Fish icons ui_item_fish_* are K-derived from the accepted sprites (no extra sheet).

sheets.name: F1
sheets.title: Cá Vàng, Cá Rô, Cá Chép, Cá Hề, Cá Nóc, Cá Thiên Thần

cells.desc: Goldfish: a round chubby orange goldfish with a soft flowing double tail and shiny orange scales
Perch: a small quick olive-green perch with faint dark stripes and a spiky but soft back fin
Carp: a calm plump golden-bronze carp with two tiny whiskers and big round scales
Clownfish: a small orange clownfish with three white stripes edged in dark brown
Pufferfish: a round yellow-and-cream pufferfish, slightly puffed, with tiny soft spikes
Angelfish: a tall silver-and-lilac angelfish with very long elegant trailing fins

sheets.name: F2
sheets.title: Cá Phát Sáng, Betta Lụa, Cá Đèn Lồng, Cá Ngựa, Koi Rồng, Cá Trăng

cells.desc: Glowfish: a small pale-mint fish with a soft turquoise belly and little light-coloured spots along its side (colour only, no glow effect)
Silk Betta: a betta with huge silky flowing fins in ruby red fading to violet
Lanternfish: a round dark-blue fish with a tiny warm-yellow lantern hanging from a stalk on its head
Seahorse: a cute coral-pink seahorse standing upright with its tail curled, its head and snout turned to the RIGHT
Dragon Koi: a majestic long koi with gleaming golden scales, red-orange patches, flowing whisker barbels and a fluttering tail
Moonfish: a round flat silver fish with a pearly sheen and pale-blue fin edges
